alt: Bar chart of the nine submissions of one real agent run, in the order they were graded: five early ones with no score, then 3.79, 15.91, 15.91 and 41.24 out of 100. Below it, tests passed by each submission: the original checker gives 2/5 or 4/5 and keeps submission 6 (3.79); the fixed checker gives 3/5 or 5/5 and keeps submission 9 (41.24).
caption: An outdated file check made a real agent run keep 3.79 out of 100 although a later submission earned 41.24. The agent orders the numbers 1 to 1000 to make a hidden cost small; one of the five tests expects an older version of a helper file, so every submission fails it. The run keeps the submission that passes the most tests and compares scores only when all five pass, so every scored submission ties at 4 of 5 and the first one stays. With the expected file version corrected, the scored submissions pass 5 of 5, each score is unchanged, and the run keeps 41.24.
